scope: Page coordinates, graphics state, paths, device colours and Contents arrays checked against the local ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text. The vector API also exercises clause 11 transparency, 8.7 analytic shadings and shading patterns, 12.5 annotation appearances and 10.6 continuous-tone halftone bypass. This is not a conformance certification.

requirements.status: vector pipeline with independent device-colour and state oracles
requirements.gaps: text and images; calibrated group blending; meshes and tiling patterns
requirements.rule: Page coordinates, initial state, rectangle construction, painting and device colours follow Tables 51, 52, 58 and 59.
Contents-array streams form one lexical sequence with separating whitespace; boundaries may occur between tokens, including within an operation, as specified in Table 31.
